entries.282c6272113404f0: The company, together with 14 consolidated subsidiaries and one equity-method affiliate, forms the group and manufactures and sells products using gravure printing, coating, lamination and molding processes. The reportable segment is a single segment, the Printing-Related Business. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, consolidated revenue was ¥49,635 million and the number of consolidated employees was 883.
entries.8bc36b55eb96657e: It handles recycled pellets (polystyrene, polypropylene), gravure printing presses and dry laminators, and base paper for heavy-duty bags, among others. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥864 million.
entries.9abd152fc22c3b3f: It manufactures and sells shrink film and lidding material for dairy products, film and molding sheets for lunch box and salad containers for convenience stores, and laminate sheets for agricultural, marine and processed food products, among others. The company's in-house developed products ＮＡＫ－Ａ－ＰＥＴ, ＮＣ－ＰＥＴ and ＮＳ－ＰＥＴ are also included in this category. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥31,607 million.
entries.9abd7a1acadf6636: It handles compression bags for bedding and clothing, DIY and eco-related products for wall and floor decoration, and kitchen and hygiene products such as cutting board sheets and kitchen mats, among others. It is manufactured at a consolidated subsidiary in China and sold to home centers and similar outlets in Japan. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥4,284 million.
entries.a459a9cb5910a6bb: It handles printed interior wallpaper and fusuma paper for housing, coated products for wet areas, and printed decorative board paper for furniture and printed film for system kitchens, among others. In the fiscal year ended February 2026, revenue was ¥1,995 million.
entries.e4b77a26db633cdf: A company that makes and sells food packaging materials, industrial films and other products using processing technologies such as gravure printing and coating.
